message.reasoning_content: John Lennon: "I'm So Tired" — Lennon only lead vocal. Penny Lane is Paul. Circles is Lennon demo? Young Blood is Beatles cover with all? "I'm So Tired" Lennon solo lead. Circles — unreleased, Lennon lead. Hmm. Young Blood (1963 BBC) lead by all three? Actually Young Blood BBC version—Lennon lead? John sang lead. But it's shared? I'll go I'm So Tired.
